text.p: Arvin Industries Inc said Wednesday that Wall Street analysts' 1997 earnings per share estimates "in the $2.10-$2.20 range for continuing operations are achievable with current economic and vehicle-build forecasts."
Arvin today reported 1996 earnings of $2.09 a share, after a gain of $0.31 a share from one-time items.
"We expect further improvement in our replacement market businesses as price increases and improved operating performance are fully realized," it said.
Original equipment performance is also expected to improve with continuing cost reductions and the impact of new product launches, it said.
"In addition, the previously announced acquisition of the remaining shares of our joint venture replacement exhaust company in Europe should increase revenue and operating profit," Arvin said.
